summary: BluSky AI Inc. filed an 8-K on May 22, 2026, reporting the appointment of Theodore P. Botts as a new board member and the entry into director agreements with Botts and Whitney Cluff. The appointments fill vacancies, but are not forced/abrupt departures; they are routine board additions with standard compensatory arrangements ($75,000 annual fee payable in shares valued at $3.65/share). No advisor is named, and no structural changes or regulatory clocks are mentioned. What to watch: whether further board changes or strategic initiatives follow; risk-arb angle is irrelevant as this is a governance event, not a deal.
